A5_S3_D5: ^Narrator: On your way to the beach, you notice a gathering of creatures in the forest, enraptured by a performance ‘onstage.’

^Beetler: But why is the kraken so evil?
^Hornbill: Oh, like many things, we cannot fully guess its purpose.
^Hornbill: Why does the Sun only rise after the Moon? And what makes seeds bloom into flowers and trees?
^Hornbill: Sometimes, that's just the way of things. But other times — those like Noah are able to try and change their fate.
^Hornbill: In this case, success didn't matter. For even if he ‘failed,’ we still tell his story.
